lines.text: He gave a load of gold to every court emir.
A writer named al Umari said Cairo's gold price fell for years.

lines.text: Historians still argue about how big that drop was.

post.caption: In 1324 Mansa Musa of Mali crossed Cairo on his pilgrimage to Mecca and gave a load of gold to every court emir. The writer al Umari said Cairo's gold price then fell for years, though historians still argue about how big the drop was. The 1375 Catalan Atlas shows him holding a gold orb, and Mali's gold came from the Bambuk and Bure goldfields.
